concept.interaction: Two players each own15 single-tail or split-tail drops and use cup_1 and cup_2 to roll the shared die_1 and die_2. They move opposite ways around the Sun, hit single opposing drops onto its exposed circular central bar, enter barred drops before other moves, and drain all15 beside their six-point home bank to win. All35 components retain the ordinary1911 Backgammon functions. The legal signature6,2 roll shows its six-point first submove: one attacker replaces a lone split-tail at the near rim and the victim lifts80 mm to the low exposed circular capture platform. Historical opening choices, whole-throw use, doubles, touch laws,1/2/3 results and series starts remain binding as detailed in RULES.md.
concept.print_stance: All35 original components retain flat-bottom print stance. Sun deck16, raised lane tops16.8, broad unobstructed center17. Existing conical dice recesses and dark pip render treatment retained.
risks: Innermost asymmetric tail overhang must leave at least90% planar own-lane support and2mm centroid-to-support-hull margin; no contact with adjacent lane.
Single-color relief and four boundary markers must be independently readable.
Digital checks do not prove physical stack stability or dice fairness.
concept.signature_decision: Exact legal hit before/after plus top overview of24 broad shallow lanes in four groups, low central capture platform, and close detail of a checker flat ON a lane with a short rounded marker BETWEEN lanes. Board distinctions use one material color.
concept.summary: Backgammon — coronal-rain theme: rival streams of condensed plasma travel magnetic lanes, scatter lone drops, and rain back into the Sun.
concept.title: Rainward Lowflow

astronomy_sources.claim: Cooling plasma follows magnetic structures and can switch paths via reconnection; competitive plugs,hits and scoring remain an analogy, not a simulation.

closest_collisions.difference: Lunar phases on conventional luxury board; here original radial plasma lanes, exposed reheating and drainage.
Circular board alone already exists; no downloaded geometry incorporated. Rainward Sun uses original35-part coronal circulation system.

period_clarification.claim: 1909 primary text explicitly rerolls tied starts and contests starts after gammon or backgammon, corroborating abbreviated1911 wording. Its divergent quadruple-scoring option is rejected.
